<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Read-Only:

- `facilities` (Attributes List) Syslog facilities that messages will be sourced from. When left empty, every facility is matched. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--facilities))
- `message_filtering` (Attributes) Optional message filtering: evaluate log message text against filter rules and allow or deny forwarding based on the match mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--message_filtering))
- `subsystems` (Attributes) Which subsystems to include in the log records. If no subsystems are selected, all subsystems will be included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--subsystems))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--facilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.facilities`

Read-Only:

- `facility` (String) Facility name or identifier used when matching log records for this operating system.
- `severity` (String) Severity level used together with the severity operator when evaluating log records for this facility.
- `severity_operator` (String) How log record severity is compared to the configured Severity for this facility (at or above the level, or exactly that level).


<a id="nestedatt--spec--message_filtering"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.message_filtering`

Read-Only:

- `match_mode` (String) Whether log messages that match the filter rules are forwarded or blocked.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Filter rules applied to log message text. If the message matches at least one rule, it is forwarded or blocked according to the match mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--message_filtering--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--message_filtering--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.message_filtering.rules`

Read-Only:

- `operator` (String) How Text is matched against the log message for filtering.
- `text` (String) Text or pattern compared to the log message using Operator.



<a id="nestedatt--spec--subsystems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.subsystems`

Read-Only:

- `extensions` (Attributes) Used to define more granular and OS-specific subsystems. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--subsystems--extensions))
- `operational` (List of String) Operational subsystems.
- `routing` (List of String) Routing-related subsystems.
- `security` (List of String) Security-related subsystems.
- `severity` (String) Severity level to filter on.
- `severity_operator` (String) Operator to determine which severity levels to filter on.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--subsystems--extensions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.subsystems.extensions`

Read-Only:

- `srl_extensions` (List of String) SR Linux-specific subsystem selector. Extensions are limited to one operating system per Source.
- `sros_extensions` (List of String) SROS-specific subsystem selector. Extensions are limited to one operating system per Source.
